text: Amortised O(1) and average-case O(1) mean the same thing.
explanation: Amortised is a worst-case bound over a *sequence* of operations — no adversary can choose inputs that make `ArrayList.add` average worse than constant, because the doubling argument holds for every sequence. Average-case is an expectation over an assumed input distribution, which an adversary can violate; `HashMap.get` is average O(1) and O(n) against chosen colliding keys, which is a real denial-of-service technique.
